_why: The GPU output store, as data (krizaka-internal#2121). Same fields as the admin's storage settings (@krizaka/storage provider registry): the Studio admin owns them in the database once the admin slice lands; this file is the launcher's bootstrap until then. A credential is a REFERENCE (a vault name), never a value. Bunny is dev only: production switches to an S3 kind (DigitalOcean Spaces tor1, AWS ca-central-1) by setting alone.
